verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an in-product AI that answers questions and completes tasks inside the Billing UI. It also documents AI that drafts product families, plans, prices and entitlements from a plain description. Official and custom MCP servers let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and similar clients act on Chargebee capabilities through natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: detail on which tasks the in-UI AI can actually perform and any guardrails, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
